$comment: Plugin code that compensates for a bb defect. `bun scripts/workarounds.ts check` probes the installed bb; `remove <id>` deletes an entry's files and marked blocks. See AGENTS.md, bb workarounds.

workarounds.defect: BB reports the same New tab selection for a generic panel open and an explicit press of the panel's New tab button. Captain Overview can take focus back during the opening window because the panel SDK exposes no selection intent.
workarounds.manual: Use the host's selection intent or default-tab support in overview-default.ts. Replace the removed pending calculation, remove the hidden pane anchor from banner.tsx, and update the New Tab tests.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/captain && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Press + as soon as a Captain's Overview appears and while the Captain lookup is held. New Tab stays selected after the lookup. A delayed automatic click on + and a click on another pane's + both leave the Captain's generic open on Overview.

workarounds.defect: bb's keyed RPC prediction (cache.updateKey) loses an earlier accepted write to a key when a later write to the same key is predicted while the server's pushed invalidation read is in flight: the first check is unticked, the first new review comment disappears and the first dismissed finding comes back until a reload, though the server stored both.
workarounds.manual: In plugins/source-control/src/app/review-data.ts, delete PendingWrites and its checks, drafts and dismissals, and predict setSelected, saveDraft, deleteDraft and dismissItem with cache.updateKey on reviewForChange again.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/source-control && bun run typecheck && bunx vitest run src/app/page/review-items.test.tsx
workarounds.verify: On a pull request's Files tab, add comments on three lines one after another: all three stay on screen without a reload. Tick two findings one after another: both stay ticked. Dismiss two findings one after another: neither comes back.

workarounds.defect: bb's source viewer (@pierre/diffs VirtualizedFile before 1.3.0) keeps a blank placeholder after being hidden with display:none and shown again.
workarounds.manual: Replace each SourceView with bb's HostSourceCode in plugins/genui/ui/components/code.tsx and FrameFooter.tsx, then delete SourceView, useTimesHidden, and their tests.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/genui && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Collapse and reopen a Code or Snippet block in a GenUI card: the source lines are drawn when it reopens.

workarounds.defect: bb's command palette (Quick palette and Search threads) handles keydown in its dialog with getShortcutCommand and runs any palette or plugin command whose shortcut matches, skipping the editable-focus context and the command's isAvailable. A bare-key binding such as vimium's `h` (Home) fires while typing into the palette's search field and closes it.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/vimium && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: With vimium's bare-key bindings (h, n, s, f), open Search threads and the Quick palette (Mod+K) and type `hens`: the dialog stays open with `hens` in the field.

workarounds.defect: bb mounts a navPanel's experimental_sidebar in an auto-height block inside the scrolling [data-sidebar="content"] column and offers no fill layout, so a sidebar whose content sizes itself with flex-1 min-h-0 (the Agent instructions project file tree) renders 0px tall.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/agent-instructions && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Open Agent instructions → Projects with a project chosen, in the left sidebar at viewport heights 400 and 1080: the file tree fills the space above its footer or the sidebar bottom, and the outer sidebar does not scroll.
workarounds.manual: Remove the useSidebarColumnFill calls and their root refs in plugins/agent-instructions/src/app/app.tsx (AgentInstructionsSidebar) and plugins/source-control/src/app/review-entry.tsx (ReviewSidebar, which then scrolls with bb's column again), then the ./sidebar-fill export in packages/ui/package.json.

workarounds.defect: bb's mobile swipe-to-open-sidebar skips a touch that starts in a horizontally scrollable element by walking parentElement from the event target, which is retargeted to a shadow host. Code scrolling inside a diff's shadow root (@pierre/diffs) is invisible to it, so the gesture takes the swipe: the code cannot scroll sideways and a right swipe opens the sidebar.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/source-control && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: On a phone (bun scripts/phone-shot.ts start iphone-17-pro), open a thread's Source Control tab and expand a file with a line wider than the screen: a left then right swipe on the code scrolls it and leaves the panel and sidebar where they were; a right swipe on a file whose code fits still closes the panel. At a 700px touch viewport, open a local change's Files tab on a long file whose only wide line is far down, scroll to it, and swipe left: the code scrolls and the right panel stays shut.

workarounds.defect: bb keeps a thread composer's permission mode in component-local state reset to the thread's last sent mode whenever the thread opens again (useThreadCreationOptions with resetKey: thread.id), and threads.update has no permissionMode, so a mode chosen on a thread but not yet sent is lost on a thread switch.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/t3-composer && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: With t3-composer enabled, pick Full Access on thread A, open thread B, then open A again: A must show Full Access without the workaround.

workarounds.defect: bb's PluginComposerBanners wraps chrome: 'card' plugin banners in <PromptStackCard ariaLabel={pluginId} className='empty:hidden'> without overflow-hidden, so opaque expanded child surfaces bleed past the 8px rounded corners.
workarounds.manual: Remove overflow-hidden rounded-lg from frameClassName in plugins/captain/src/app/banner.tsx once PluginComposerBanners adds overflow-hidden.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/captain && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Open an expanded Captain ask banner in bb Monokai dark, default dark, and default light: its popover panel corners clip cleanly to the 8px card radius.

workarounds.defect: bb's PromptStackCard renders 1px border-border hairlines beneath child fills, applies activityRowClass('active') wash/ring on core rows (Plan/Goal, background agents, child threads, to-do), darkens headers on hover (hover:bg-background/80) without a light-mode lift token, sets minHeight: 35 on ThreadPromptContextBanner, reserves a 1px transparent border-top on collapsed disclosure bodies, renders Active child threads and Queue labels at font-normal, inverts background-agent label/value colors and shines its value, and applies .animate-shine-icon masking to running banner icons.
workarounds.manual: Remove the prompt-stack-banner-style import and mount calls from scripts/prompt-banner-contract.test.ts once bb core ships unified PromptStackCard chrome, lightening hover tokens, flat active rows, label/value grammar, and static banner icons.
afterRemoval: cd plugins/t3-composer && bun run typecheck && bun run test
workarounds.verify: Open a thread with Captain, Source Control, bb--git changed files, Plan, Active child threads, and 1-item/2-item background agents across bb Monokai dark, default dark, and default light: every banner shares the same 32px height, crisp hairline, flat rest surface, disclosure divider, medium foreground labels, muted values (keeping 10px text-2xs badges), lightening hover without wiping :focus-visible rings or styling body buttons, and un-animated leading icons (preserving PluginAssetIcon masks).
